metadata.description: Canada venture capital annual totals (CVCA / BDC, CAD)
metadata.primary_source: BDC Canada VC Landscape 2025 (for 2015–2024 history); CVCA Year-End 2024 (for 2020–2024 quarterly detail); CVCA Q1-2025 (for revised 2024 figure)
metadata.notes: CVCA revised 2024 upward from $7.9B to $8.5B on May 14, 2025. The $8.5B figure is authoritative. 2025 confirmed by user as $8.0B from CVCA Year-End 2025 (not yet in BDC report). 2015–2019 from BDC Figure 2 which uses PitchBook source — may differ slightly from CVCA member data.

data.source: BDC Figure 2 (PitchBook data). CVCA-sourced equivalent not available in extracted documents.
BDC Figure 2 ($6.6B). CVCA Q1-2024 report cites $6.5B — $100M rounding difference. Use midpoint $6.5–6.6B.
CVCA Year-End 2024 chart + BDC Figure 2 (both confirm $4.6B, 527–530 deals).
CVCA Year-End 2024 + Q1-2025 confirm $15.4B/842–846 deals. BDC shows $15.7B — small methodology difference. Use $15.4B (CVCA preferred).
CVCA Year-End 2024 ($10.4B/768 deals). BDC shows $10.5B/755 deals. Close.
CVCA Year-End 2024 + Q1-2025 confirm $7.1B. Deals: 688–690 range.
CVCA revised figure (published May 2025, per CVCA Q1-2025 report and BDC footnote). Original publication was $7.9B/592 deals.
CVCA Year-End 2025 (confirmed by user). KPMG quarterly sum for 2025 = $8.54B CAD — within range given methodology differences.

alt_series_kpmg_pitchbook.description: KPMG/PitchBook Canada annual totals (derived by summing quarterly data from KPMG Q1-2026 report). In CAD millions. Systematically ~10–15% lower than CVCA for 2020–2024.
